summary: Iteration 7 backend + frontend E2E. All 3 blockers verified fixed and both new P1 features (Shift Comments, Overtime auto-detect + approval) working. Added new pytest suite (17/17 pass). One frontend routing bug found and fixed: /dashboard/overtime route was not registered in App.js even though the sidebar linked to it and OvertimePage was imported.

minor.issue: test_payroll_create_and_duplicate_blocked in the old suite fails on re-run because iteration_6 already seeded a payroll for user+month=today+year=today+5. Not a product bug — just test-data reuse. New iter7 tests do not have this issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Route path='overtime' was missing even though OvertimePage was imported and the sidebar linked to /dashboard/overtime. Result: navigating to /dashboard/overtime rendered nothing (React Router warning 'No routes matched location'). Fixed by adding <Route path="overtime" element={<OvertimePage />} />

issues: Spec says filter chips are for admin only; employee page also renders pending/approved/rejected/all chips. Minor spec deviation — functional but not spec-strict.

action_items: (Fixed by tester) Add missing <Route path='overtime' element={<OvertimePage/>} /> in /app/frontend/src/App.js. Please review the one-line change.
Consider hiding ot-filter-* chips for employees per spec, or update the spec to explicitly permit employees to filter their own overtime by status.
Timezone limitation flagged in iteration_6 still present (shifts.py join/end compares UTC hour/min against local start_time) — not in this iteration's scope.
critical_code_review_comments: shifts.py:262 end_shift always resets shift.status to 'scheduled' even after cancel/ending — same as iter6 note.

shift_comments.py:23 _notify does not skip when from_user == recipient in the admin-post-to-self edge case (admin employee whose own shift was created for themselves would get a self-notification). Low priority.
overtime.py:157 approve_overtime stores reviewer_id as user['_id'] (already str from utils.auth.get_current_user) — consistent. reviewer_name falls back to persisted value in _build_response.
overtime.py create_or_update_overtime_request: on duplicate call in 'approved'/'rejected' state it returns True but does not update numbers — good idempotency.
attendance.py check_out: overtime creation is wrapped in bare try/except which will swallow real bugs (e.g. ImportError). Consider logging the exception.
App.js: OvertimePage was imported without the route registered — indicates missing lint rule 'no-unused-vars' guard or missing PR test.

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 new iter7 tests; 13/14 legacy — 1 failure is stale seed data, not a product bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% after tester's App.js route fix (was 0% for overtime page before fix)

NOTE: main agent should verify the App.js router change is what they want; if OvertimePage is intentionally not routed yet, remove the sidebar entry instead.
rca_of_the_issue: OvertimePage component was created and imported in App.js and referenced from DashboardLayout sidebar as /dashboard/overtime, but the corresponding <Route> was omitted. React Router matched the parent /dashboard layout but had no child route → rendered empty index outlet content and logged 'No routes matched location /dashboard/overtime'. Fix: add <Route path="overtime" element={<OvertimePage />} /> under the dashboard layout Route. Verified both admin (with 4 filter chips) and employee (My Overtime) load correctly after the fix.
